title: Hearty Winey Thai New Potatoes Khao Soi
description: A winey and velvety Thai dish featuring new potatoes, inspired by Bangkok street food, and served in a talavera plate.
instructions: In a large pot, boil the diced new potatoes in salted water until they are slightly tender.
In a blender or food processor, combine shio-koji, red curry paste, and a splash of water to make a smooth paste.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the curry paste mixture until fragrant.
Add the cooked potatoes, coconut milk, white wine, fish sauce, and brown sugar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the potatoes are fully tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in chopped cilantro and cook for an additional minute.
To serve, place cooked rice noodles in a talavera plate, then spoon the potato and sauce mixture over the top.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
